MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which tone does mǎ (horse) have? (1 mark)
   A. The first tone, which is flat
   B. The second tone, which rises
   C. The third tone, which dips and rises
   D. The fourth tone, which falls

2. How is 你好 nǐ hǎo really said? (1 mark)
   A. Like nǐ hào
   B. Like ní hǎo
   C. Like nī hǎo
   D. Like nì hǎo

3. What does 那 (nà) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Older brother
   B. Older sister
   C. Younger brother
   D. That

4. What do we call a word made of two syllables blended together? (1 mark)
   A. A final
   B. A disyllabic word
   C. A stroke
   D. An initial

5. Which word means "under" in 椅子在桌子下? (1 mark)
   A. 下
   B. 上
   C. 桌
   D. 在

6. Fill the blank: 电视在桌子____。 (The television is on the table.) (1 mark)
   A. 在
   B. 上
   C. 里
   D. 下

7. Which sentence means "Today is Wednesday."? (1 mark)
   A. 星期五,去清真寺。
   B. 星期天,去教堂。
   C. 我星期三去学校。
   D. 今天星期三。

8. In 我的生日是三月五号, on which date is the birthday? (1 mark)
   A. 5 May
   B. 3 May
   C. 5 March
   D. 3 March

9. Fill the blank: 祝你生日____! (Happy birthday!) (1 mark)
   A. 快乐
   B. 朋友
   C. 礼物
   D. 蛋糕

10. Which is a good active listening habit? (1 mark)
   A. Face the speaker and listen for key words
   B. Think about lunch
   C. Look at the wall
   D. Talk to your friend

11. What does 喝 (hē) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Milk
   B. To eat
   C. To drink
   D. Drinks

12. Which Chinese word means "tea"? (1 mark)
   A. 葡萄 pútao
   B. 茶 chá
   C. 喝 hē
   D. 午饭 wǔfàn

13. What does 饮料 (yǐnliào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Drinks
   B. Meat
   C. Beef
   D. Dinner

14. What does 大 (dà) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Drought
   B. Big
   C. It rains
   D. Snow

15. Why do we read greetings with a friendly face? (1 mark)
   A. It changes the tones
   B. It makes the words longer
   C. It changes the voice to sound friendly
   D. It hides the words

16. What does 谢谢 (xièxie) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Teacher
   B. Hello
   C. I, me
   D. Thank you

17. Which sentence means "This is my older sister."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是我姐姐。
   B. 那是我弟弟。
   C. 我爱你。
   D. 这是我爸爸。

18. What does 对 duì mean in a true-or-false exercise? (1 mark)
   A. Wrong
   B. Family
   C. Father
   D. Right

19. What does 哪儿 (nǎr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Window
   B. Toilet
   C. Where
   D. House

20. What does 星期五,去清真寺 mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Friday, go to the mosque
   B. On Friday, rest at home
   C. On Monday, go to school
   D. On Sunday, go to church

21. Which word is pronounced jiàotáng? (1 mark)
   A. 去
   B. 明天
   C. 教堂
   D. 清真寺

22. Which sentence means "My friend gives me a gift."? (1 mark)
   A. 我们切蛋糕。
   B. 祝你生日快乐!
   C. 朋友送我礼物。
   D. 我的生日是三月五号。

23. What does 嘴巴 (zuǐba) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mouth
   B. To use
   C. Ear
   D. To wash hands

24. Which Chinese word means "hand"? (1 mark)
   A. 刷牙 shuāyá
   B. 手 shǒu
   C. 用 yòng
   D. 耳朵 ěrduo

25. Which Chinese word means "knee"? (1 mark)
   A. 耳朵 ěrduo
   B. 刷牙 shuāyá
   C. 膝盖 xīgài
   D. 脚 jiǎo

26. What does 不 (bù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Small
   B. Weather
   C. Very
   D. Not

27. Which character has an extra dot compared with 大? (1 mark)
   A. 人
   B. 天
   C. 入
   D. 太

28. Why do we pause when we read aloud? (1 mark)
   A. To read faster
   B. To breathe and show where ideas begin and end
   C. To change tones
   D. To forget words

29. What does 下面 (xiàmiàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fridge
   B. Below
   C. Table
   D. Bathroom

30. Which stroke goes from left to right? (1 mark)
   A. 撇 piě
   B. 横 héng
   C. 点 diǎn
   D. 竖 shù

31. Which part is common to the characters 妈, 姐 and 妹? (1 mark)
   A. 未
   B. 且
   C. 女
   D. 马

32. Which pattern says what is in a room? (1 mark)
   A. Thing + 有 + 里 + place
   B. Place + 里 + 有 + thing
   C. 有 + place + thing
   D. Place + thing + 里

33. What does 快乐 (kuàilè) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Plate
   B. Birthday
   C. Cake
   D. Happy

34. What does 礼物 (lǐwù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To play
   B. Knife
   C. Gift
   D. We

35. Which punctuation mark do we use between items in a list? (1 mark)
   A. 。
   B. 、
   C. ?
   D. !

36. Which word is pronounced yǐnliào? (1 mark)
   A. 饼
   B. 饮料
   C. 鸡肉
   D. 晚饭

37. What does 菠菜 (bōcài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Spinach
   B. Apple
   C. Dinner
   D. Mango

38. Which word is pronounced xǐshǒu? (1 mark)
   A. 说
   B. 肩膀
   C. 头
   D. 洗手

39. What does 洗手 (xǐshǒu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Ear
   B. To wash hands
   C. Tooth
   D. Two (before a counting word)

40. What does 房子 (fángzi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Bed
   B. House
   C. Cat
   D. Window

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is a banana." (2 marks)

42. Name the days of the week from Monday to Wednesday in Chinese with pinyin. (3 marks)

43. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Happy birthday to you!" and "When is your birthday?" (4 marks)

44. Write three things you could include in a class display and one thing to check. (3 marks)

45. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 天 and 老师. (2 marks)

46. Write in Chinese with pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door." (2 marks)

47. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Saturday I rest at home." (3 marks)

48. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Goodbye!" and "Thank you!" (4 marks)

49. Write a short text of five sentences saying what you eat for each meal, in Chinese with pinyin. (5 marks)

50. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 清真寺 and 一. (2 marks)

51. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 喜欢 and 哪儿. (2 marks)

52. Describe how to work out the meaning of an unknown word in a sentence. (3 marks)

53. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "That is my older brother." (2 marks)

54. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is the sun." (2 marks)

55. How do you write ü after j, q and x? Give one example. (2 marks)

56. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There is a bed in the bedroom." (2 marks)

57. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There is a television in the living room." (3 marks)

58. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my eyes to see." and "I use my ears to hear." (4 marks)

59. Tell how to tell 大 dà from 太 tài by looking. (2 marks)

60. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 饮料, 两 and 刀. (3 marks)

61. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: jīntiān xià yǔ. (2 marks)

62. Add punctuation to: 我喜欢芒果香蕉葡萄你呢 (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — The third tone, which dips and rises
   The mark ǎ is a small V, which is the dipping third tone.

2. B — Like ní hǎo
   Two third tones together: the first changes to the second tone.

3. D — That
   那 (nà) means that.

4. B — A disyllabic word
   Dis means two, so a disyllabic word has two syllables.

5. A — 下
   下 xià means under or below.

6. B — 上
   上 means on.

7. D — 今天星期三。
   今天星期三。 (jīntiān xīngqīsān.) means "Today is Wednesday.".

8. C — 5 March
   三月 is March and 五号 is the fifth.

9. A — 快乐
   生日快乐 is happy birthday.

10. A — Face the speaker and listen for key words
   Active listeners give the speaker attention and catch the key words.

11. C — To drink
   喝 (hē) means to drink.

12. B — 茶 chá
   茶 (chá) means tea.

13. A — Drinks
   饮料 (yǐnliào) means drinks.

14. B — Big
   大 (dà) means big.

15. C — It changes the voice to sound friendly
   A smile changes the sound of your voice.

16. D — Thank you
   谢谢 (xièxie) means thank you.

17. A — 这是我姐姐。
   这是我姐姐。 (zhè shì wǒ jiějie.) means "This is my older sister.".

18. D — Right
   对 means right; 错 means wrong.

19. C — Where
   哪儿 (nǎr) means where.

20. A — On Friday, go to the mosque
   清真寺 is a mosque.

21. C — 教堂
   教堂 is pronounced jiàotáng and means church.

22. C — 朋友送我礼物。
   朋友送我礼物。 (péngyou sòng wǒ lǐwù.) means "My friend gives me a gift.".

23. A — Mouth
   嘴巴 (zuǐba) means mouth.

24. B — 手 shǒu
   手 (shǒu) means hand.

25. C — 膝盖 xīgài
   膝盖 (xīgài) means knee.

26. D — Not
   不 (bù) means not.

27. D — 太
   太 is 大 with an extra dot.

28. B — To breathe and show where ideas begin and end
   Pauses help the reader and the listener.

29. B — Below
   下面 (xiàmiàn) means below.

30. B — 横 héng
   横 is the horizontal stroke.

31. C — 女
   女 means woman or female.

32. B — Place + 里 + 有 + thing
   For example 卧室里有床。

33. D — Happy
   快乐 (kuàilè) means happy.

34. C — Gift
   礼物 (lǐwù) means gift.

35. B — 、
   、 is the list comma.

36. B — 饮料
   饮料 is pronounced yǐnliào and means drinks.

37. A — Spinach
   菠菜 (bōcài) means spinach.

38. D — 洗手
   洗手 is pronounced xǐshǒu and means to wash hands.

39. B — To wash hands
   洗手 (xǐshǒu) means to wash hands.

40. B — House
   房子 (fángzi) means house.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是香蕉。 zhè shì xiāngjiāo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期一 xīngqīyī, 星期二 xīngqī'èr, 星期三 xīngqīsān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each day.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè! 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example a labelled house plan, a birthday card and character models; check tone marks and stroke order.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each item and 1 mark for a check.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 天: tiān, sky, day. 老师: lǎoshī, teacher.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我星期六在家休息。 wǒ xīngqīliù zài jiā xiūxi.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: 再见! zàijiàn! 谢谢! xièxie!
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

49. (5 marks)
   Answer: 我早饭吃饼,喝茶。我午饭吃米饭和鸡肉。我晚饭吃米饭和菠菜。我喜欢水果。 wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng, hē chá. wǒ wǔfàn chī mǐfàn hé jīròu. wǒ wǎnfàn chī mǐfàn hé bōcài. wǒ xǐhuan shuǐguǒ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence with correct verbs and pinyin.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: 清真寺: qīngzhēnsì, mosque. 一: yī, one.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: 喜欢: xǐhuan, to like. 哪儿: nǎr, where.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Read the whole sentence, look at the words you know, look at pictures, then guess and check with a friend or dictionary.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three steps.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: 那是我哥哥。 nà shì wǒ gēge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是太阳。 zhè shì tàiyáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is written as u, for example qù (to go).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the rule and 1 mark for the example.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: 卧室里有床。 wòshì lǐ yǒu chuáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: 客厅里有电视。 kètīng lǐ yǒu diànshì.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

58. (4 marks)
   Answer: 我用眼睛看。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. 我用耳朵听。 wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: 太 has an extra dot at the bottom right.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the dot and 1 mark for naming the two characters correctly.

60. (3 marks)
   Answer: 饮料: yǐnliào, drinks. 两: liǎng, two (before a counting word). 刀: dāo, knife.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: Today it rains.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

62. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我喜欢芒果、香蕉、葡萄。你呢?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 、, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for ?.
